ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported mixed Q1 FY27 results, showing a slight year-on-year revenue increase but a decline in net profit and Earnings Per Share (EPS) compared to both the previous quarter and year. Concurrently, the board approved a significant share buyback program of up to INR 697 million, alongside strategic moves to acquire the remaining stake in JC Biotech (making it a Wholly Owned Subsidiary) and infuse funds into Advanced Nutrazyme Private Limited. While the buyback and subsidiary investments indicate positive capital allocation and growth strategies, the observed dip in profitability warrants attention.
